content.text: Digital creators in Kenya often face severe limitations when it comes to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-without-stripe-which-architecture-actually-16|COREMERCH guide to selling]] their products online. Traditional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, leaving creators with few options to monetize their work effectively. This guide is designed to walk you through the process of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-everything-you-12|setting]] up a sovereign commerce infrastructure that leverages cryptocurrency for payment processing. By utilizing free and accessible tools, you can establish an online store that allows you to sell digital products such as ebooks, courses, and software without relying on conventional platforms. The Complete Builder Kit is your all-in-one solution to get [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-complete-10|How to]]ed, ensuring that you own your infrastructure and data.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Many digital creators are restricted by platforms that do not serve their needs. COREMERCH's infrastructure addresses the core issue: ownership and sovereignty. When you deploy your own commerce stack, you are not reliant on third-party services that can deny access or impose fees. This system is built to withstand the challenges of payment rejections and currency fluctuations. By using blockchain technology, you gain access to a borderless payment system with lower fees and faster transaction times. This is not a workaround; it’s a complete solution that empowers you to take control of your business. With no reliance on traditional payment processors, you can focus on what matters: creating and selling your digital products.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can launch your digital products, you need to gather the necessary tools. First, sign up for a NOWPayments account to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. You will also need a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which offer free hosting solutions. For backend logic, familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers—both essential for automating operations. Additionally, set up a storage solution for your orders, such as Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, prepare your digital products for upload, ensuring they are ready for instant delivery. This preparation phase is crucial for a smooth deployment and operation once your infrastructure is live.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With your tools in place, follow these steps to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. Begin by configuring NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrencies, choosing networks like BSC or Solana for low transaction fees. Next, implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle payment confirmations and product delivery. This allows you to automate the process so that customers receive their products instantly upon payment verification. Use a storage solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to host your digital files, ensuring they are securely accessible. By the end of this step, your infrastructure will be ready to process transactions seamlessly, putting you in full control of your commerce operations.
You own your data and infrastructure, ensuring long-term sustainability.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery mechanisms are set, it’s time to go live. Start by testing your infrastructure with a small number of transactions to ensure everything runs smoothly. Promote your products on social media and use crypto-specific forums to reach your target audience. When a customer makes a purchase, your NOWPayments integration will automatically verify the transaction on-chain, triggering the delivery of the product stored in your server. Keep an eye on the performance of your infrastructure during these initial sales. Troubleshoot any issues that arise and optimize your setup to ensure the best experience for your customers. This is the moment when you realize that your sovereign commerce infrastructure is working as intended.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your first transactions, consider how to scale your operations. Start by analyzing customer feedback to improve your offerings and delivery process. Increase your product range by adding more digital products like templates or plugins. This is where the Complete Builder Kit comes into play; it provides additional blueprints and templates to enhance your store’s functionality. Focus on enhancing marketing efforts—target niche markets and explore collaborations with other creators to widen your reach. Also, monitor your transaction volume and consider upgrading your storage or delivery options if necessary. Scaling your business should be a data-driven process, ensuring you maintain quality and efficiency as you grow.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To start selling digital products with crypto, establish your sovereign commerce infrastructure using free tools. Set up a NOWPayments account for cryptocurrency processing, host your site on GitHub or Cloudflare Pages, and automate the delivery of products with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. The Complete Builder Kit is an excellent resource to streamline this process, providing all necessary blueprints and templates.
Instant delivery of digital products enhances customer satisfaction.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those ready to dive deeper into building a robust digital store, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is essential. This kit offers comprehensive resources that simplify the process of setting up and scaling your digital commerce infrastructure, ensuring that you’re well-equipped to succeed in a digital marketplace where traditional payment methods fall short.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Sign up for a NOWPayments account and choose suitable cryptocurrency networks. 2. Set up a free hosting environment using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Implement backend logic through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automation. 4. Prepare a secure storage solution like Supabase or Google Drive for your digital products. 5. Conduct testing of your infrastructure with sample transactions. 6. Promote your digital products through social media and crypto communities. 7. Analyze performance and gather customer feedback to make necessary adjustments.
Frequently Asked Questions
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
Through NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and many others, providing flexibility for your customers.
How do I ensure my digital products are delivered securely?
By utilizing Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for storage and automating delivery through Apps Script, you ensure that products are securely delivered upon payment confirmation.
What if I want to add more products later?
Your infrastructure is designed to be scalable. You can easily add more digital products at any time without disrupting your existing setup.
Is there support available after deployment?
Yes, with the Complete Builder Kit, you receive not only the tools but also support to help you navigate any challenges you might encounter.
Can I customize my online store?
Absolutely. With the tools provided, you have full control over the design and functionality of your store, allowing for a personalized customer experience.
